name: CoralFactory
caption: A densely branching coral rendered as a textured 3D model. The coral features an intricate, highly detailed network of fine branches and sub-branches radiating outward in all directions from a central base, creating a spreading bush-like form. Each branch is covered in small polyp bumps and encrusting organisms, giving a cream-ivory to pale green coloration with organic depth. The overall silhouette is wide and irregular, casting an elaborate shadow pattern on the white background.
